## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what was wrong or missing and how this change affects a student or maintainer.

## Evidence

List primary source URLs, versions, verification dates and any remaining unknowns.

## Validation

Record commands actually run and their outcomes. Separate fixture tests from live integration, browser and tool-execution checks.

## Review

- [ ] Content is original or appropriately licensed; no exam dumps or private data.
- [ ] Untrusted source data remains data and cannot modify executable workflows.
- [ ] New tool or curriculum claims have a separate reviewer before approval.
- [ ] Coverage and limitations are updated; no untested work is labeled complete.
